name: A unit created mid-month is charged from its creation date
title: SC-07-09-02 A unit created mid-month is charged from its creation date
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given proration is enabled for the site
And unit "C-2" with monthly dues of 1800.00 is created on "2026-11-16"
When period "2026-11" is accrued
Then unit "C-2" owes 900.00 for period "2026-11"
